Fix `packages/excalidraw/data/index.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Source bug, AC-4 and FR-18: packages/excalidraw/tests/pagesExport.test.tsx > export of paged drawings > embedded PNG scene holds one page and only its elements fails with `expected [ 'active_1', 'active_2', 'other_1' ] to deeply equal [ 'active_1', 'active_2' ]`. In exportCanvas's `type === "png"` branch, the embedded metadata calls serializeAsJSON(elements, scopeAppStateToActivePage(appState), files, "local") without filtering elements by page, so the scene embedded in a PNG can hold other pages' elements. Pass getActivePageElements(elements, appState), the same filter scene/export.ts applies to its own embedded metadata (exportToBlob). Import it the way scene/export.ts does. Check that no other embed in exportCanvas serializes unfiltered elements, and leave the JSON file save, which writes the whole drawing, alone.
